dct_title_s: Eastern archipelago, Bali Strait and included anchorages : from Netherlands Government surveys between 1902 and 1907
dct_description_sm: Nautical chart of the Bali Strait showing the eastern coast of Java and the western coast of Bali. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. Depth shown by bathymetric soundings.
In lower left margin: Small corrections printed: July '40, Feb. '42, From notices to Mariners '41-40. From other sources: VII '40, II '42.
Ancillary maps: Java-east coast, Banyuwangi Road -- Bali-west coast, Chupel Road. Scale 1:50,224 -- Bali-southwest coast, Pulukan Road. Scale 1:50,224 -- Bali-south coast, Pantaibarat Bay.
Stanford copy only has small corrections to July '40.
dct_publisher_sm: Published Nov. 1919, at the Hydrographic Office, under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy
